How long does an Apotheca candle burn?

Each holds 240 g of natural, vegetable-based wax, about 50 hours of burning.

Which scents are there?

Nigrum Tulipa (black tulip and amber), Purpura (fig leaf and sandalwood), Vipera (spicy-sweet musk and guaiac wood), Vitae (orange blossom and mandarin) and Insidiae (bitter citrus and bergamot).

Right here. Every order leaves us within 2 business days with tracking, and orders over $200 ship free. Browse the scents by family in Shop by scent.

baobab-collection.faq:
Good to know

Where can I buy Baobab Collection in Canada?

Right here. Every order leaves us within 2 business days with tracking, and orders over $200 ship free. Candles also ship to the United States; diffusers and refills ship within Canada only.

What do the MAX sizes mean?

The number is the candle’s height in centimetres: MAX 08 Petite (190 g, about 40 hours), MAX 10 Classique (500 g, about 50 hours), MAX 16 Signature (1.1 kg, about 100 hours), MAX 24 Grande (3 kg, about 340 hours) and MAX 35 Monument (6.5 kg, about 600 hours).

How long does a Totem refill last?

One 1 litre refill fills the 250 ml Totem diffuser four times.

Browse by family in Shop by scent, or upload a photo of your room and we suggest pieces that suit it.

Is Evelyne Prélonge the same as Maison Prélonge?

Yes. The French maison now goes by Maison Prélonge, and its pieces are still designed, cut and assembled in its French ateliers.

Is it real fur?

No. The maison is fur-free, cruelty-free and PETA-approved.

hypsoe.faq:
Good to know

How does a refillable candle work?

The shell stays. When the 200 g candle is finished, lift out its tin and drop in a refill in any of 8 scents, each about 40 hours of burning. The refills fit the 11 cm wooden shells and the Dolmen concrete shell.

And the XL candle?

The XL wooden shell holds a 600 g candle, about 80 hours of burning.

How do the Still candlesticks work?

A spring inside lifts the candle as it burns, so the flame always sits at the top. Refills come in boxes of nine.
